page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance built on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 16 dedicated physical CPU cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not feature any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be handled via network-attached volumes. Network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated CPU cores and an entry-level NVIDIA P4 GPU offers a budget-friendly option for hardware-accelerated tasks that do not demand modern tensor cores. This resource profile is suited for workloads such as lightweight machine learning inference, video transcoding, and graphics rendering.
